{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABWGTmnA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6Pzg_pWFA", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 42, "title": "Add one-command download and safe local import of MMD test models", "body": "## Goal

Make **local real-MMD-model visual testing a one-command setup** wherever the creator/source actually permits unattended direct download. Currently every optional SDEF, bone, group, material, UV, grant and physics-layer viewer expects separately downloaded private PMX files, making hands-on checks cumbersome. Add an **opt-in developer command** (e.g. `npm run models:setup -- gene`) that downloads verified original PMX, required textures and notices directly into an existing loopback viewer's Git-ignored private area; document selection and loading in the viewer.

**Do not attempt to automate protected BowlRoll downloads or bypass any creator's access restrictions.** This issue must truthfully distinguish auto-downloadable models from those requiring manual acquisition.

## Initial verified source for automation: CG-CA Gene

Repository: https://github.com/mmdagent-ex/gene

- Author/publisher README: https://github.com/mmdagent-ex/gene/blob/main/README.md
- Public GitHub model: `Gene.pmx`; textures: `tex/` (the repository also offers `Gene_light.pmx` and `light/`); sample motions under `motion/`.
- Initial inspected source commit: `c7eace43dffaccff6ad0597433ef85fa57c91e03`. **Pin an exact commit and file hashes in a manifest, verify downloaded contents before using them and never download from mutable main implicitly.** Refresh explicitly after review.
- The creator README describes **CC BY 4.0 for the files**, provides attribution `CG-CA Gene (c) 2023 by Nagoya Institute of Technology, Moonshot R&D Goal 1 Avatar Symbiotic Society`, and states **additional trademark/design usage constraints**: academic purposes and personal non-commercial uses are permitted; other commercial use requires contacting the author. Preserve/print these notices so downloading for private testing does not falsely imply unrestricted commercial use.
- This model is confirmed to exist as a public PMX with textures, many morphs and physics. **Its internal SDEF flags, exact morph types, grants, and after-physics cases are NOT verified.** The setup should introspect the actual PMX after downloading and list which feature tests it can genuinely support; do not claim it replaces YYB Miku or the other specialized candidate models for every feature.

Existing public examples already have an automatic downloader: `npm run examples:assets`, implemented in `scripts/fetch-example-assets.ts` with a pinned Three.js r171 commit + Git blob hash verification. Reuse this trustworthy pattern and, where useful, allow local viewers to inspect the assets already installed by that command instead of downloading duplicates. Do not alter which assets are publicly deployed.

## Protected/manual-only sources

Examples: YYB式初音ミク 10th, DONburi Room cardboard box/autogroove, the vinyl umbrella, wire rope, PAC clock tower and 天月りよん when distributed via BowlRoll or another restricted/passworded destination.

- **Do not implement a BowlRoll scraper, headless/login bot, password extraction, login-cookie reuse, CAPTCHA circumvention, direct-download endpoint reverse engineering, or mass automated collection.** BowlRoll's terms (https://bowlroll.net/about/rules) prohibit automated collection of other users' content without permission.
- Do not try to auto-download from a passworded or approval-gated source merely because a URL appears in an Issue. Require clear creator authorization and an expressly permitted programmatic source before adding a model to the automatic manifest.
- When such a model must be manually acquired, minimize work: offer **local import** of a user-supplied archive or directory (e.g. `npm run models:import -- /path/to/archive.zip --category sdef`). Preserve texture-relative paths, detect PMX files, display per-model terms for the user to inspect, reject traversal, symlinks, archive bombs and executable content; never upload/rehost the imported files. The user should not need to manually build complex directory trees.
- If a source becomes unavailable or cannot be verified, show a helpful source-specific explanation and keep generated PMX fixtures as the fallback. No silent replacement with an unrelated PMX.

## Behavior

1. Provide a clearly documented **opt-in one-command local setup** and list/catalog of supported automatic sources with origin, pinned revision/hash, license/usage summary and genuinely supported feature categories. Download only selected sources; cache by verified hash; skip identical files. Support rerun/offline use and report clear network/integrity errors.
2. Download PMX, dependency textures and upstream README/notices as an intact local model directory, under `examples/assets/private/` or another Git-ignored private path. Handle nested/Unicode filenames and preserve exact case.
3. Auto-detect and report (via released `mmd-parser`) SDEF skinning count; morph types 0–8; group→bone/material/UV links; additional UV channels; `envFlag=3`; grant flags; pre/post-physics bone flags; rigid body modes; associated VMD if present. Mark features as *not demonstrated* when absent. Optionally expose the result via a private viewer model selector / visible diagnostic report.
4. Permit local viewing after setup via existing `npm run dev:sdef` loopback-only viewer without editing HTML/TypeScript. Keep the existing private model workflows functional.
5. Respect third-party terms and attribution. Never include downloaded third-party assets, archives, full unreviewed license copies in Git commits, npm packs, browser public examples, GitHub Pages deploy output or CI artifacts. **Existing public examples/models/motions/screenshots/URLs/asset manifest remain unchanged.** Do not imply a license granted to unrelated models.
6. No automatic third-party model download during `npm install`, `npm test`, `npm run build:examples`, Actions workflows or Pages deployment. Download is *only* a direct, explicit developer action. CI must work offline with generated fixtures.

## Automated pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Source manifest validation and actual source provenance/revision/license review, including a pinned verified GitHub commit for Gene; model and each dependency path are correct.
- [ ] Tests with controlled local HTTP fixture server exercise fresh download, retries, partial/corrupt response rejection, checksum failure, caching, idempotence, offline re-run and deterministic path placement (without network dependency).
- [ ] Integration with a generated PMX with textures verifies imported/downloaded model discovery and per-feature metadata reporting; absent features must not be advertised as tested.
- [ ] User-provided archive importer validates safe extraction, nested Unicode texture paths, archive boundaries, traversal/symlink prevention and resource limits. Missing/invalid model and unsupported source are reported without corrupting existing assets.
- [ ] Strictly reject unauthorized/protected URL auto-download by default; no credential handling or bypass routes. Add no CI or dependency lifecycle remote fetches.
- [ ] Tests prove downloaded/private files are excluded from npm pack, public example site/Pages, original public asset manifest and CI artifacts.
- [ ] Existing SDEF/bone/group/material/UV/Grant/physics local viewers still run, and the new model picker works without a public model download.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `MMD_EXAMPLE_FIXTURES=1 npm run build:examples`, `npm run test:examples`, and isolated package JS/TS tests pass **before merge**.
- [ ] No manual third-party download, licensor contact, visual approval or **post-merge validation** is required for completion of this implementation Issue; auto-fetch at least the positively identified permitted Gene source. Unsupported passworded models remain explicitly manual-only.

## Required post-merge verification

**None** for this Issue. Maintainer-led model viewing is optional and separate. Existing optional visual-check Issue [#30](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/30) stays open until the maintainer records actual results.

- [Existing private viewer/server](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/scripts/serve-sdef.ts)
- [Gene original model files, README and usage terms](https://github.com/mmdagent-ex/gene)
- [BowlRoll terms](https://bowlroll.net/about/rules)
